verdict.rationale: DeepSeek's own API docs include runnable code examples: a function-calling guide with runnable OpenAI-format examples, and a first-call guide with stream/non-stream examples in both OpenAI and Anthropic formats. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference such as an in-browser try-it console or explorer. Missing for 10: an interactive API reference or explorer, in-browser execution of examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: A maintained function-calling guide with runnable OpenAI-format examples (stream or non-stream)
